**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 246

You are adept at living in the wilderness, foraging for food and building shelter, and with training you discover the secrets of tracking and hiding your trail.

<title level="2">Survival Untrained General Actions</title>

- [Subsist](/Skills.aspx?ID=25&General=true) in the wild by foraging for food and building shelter.
